rules: Evidence Integration does not adjudicate deception, knowledge, Lie Ledger eligibility, award counts, or Web of Lies lineage.
Existing WOL and Lie Ledger findings remain frozen unless the specialist lane accepts a new source-backed claim atom.
Attributed reporting is not converted into an adverse source finding merely because a later official denial exists.

referrals.subject: IRGC claim that the U.S. knows Iran is not seeking nuclear weapons and that Iran's nuclear program is peaceful
referrals.note: Atomize nuclear-intent and U.S.-knowledge propositions separately; no deception score assigned here.

referrals.subject: IRGC claim minimizing protected Hormuz passage versus Kpler partial-recovery data
referrals.note: Compare exact quantitative/rhetorical proposition against existing Hormuz-control families and commercial flow data; do not equate half-prewar oil exports with full opening.

referrals.subject: Anonymous-official reports of U.S. economic relief terms versus Trump's public denial
referrals.note: Preserve as competing attributions unless independent evidence resolves the underlying offer terms.

referrals.subject: Ethan Levins repeated the sanctions-relief/frozen-assets report with explicit Axios attribution
referrals.note: Do not score automatically. Attribution to Axios is material; compare wording against the source report and later presidential denial.

referrals.subject: Ethan Levins stated that New York negotiations led to nothing and the Iranian delegation was flying home
referrals.note: Separate the factual departure claim from the categorical implication that diplomacy produced nothing or ended. Current reporting preserves continuing mediator exchanges after Araghchi's departure.

referrals.subject: Valenti Videos title: Iran prepares for a "Doomsday War" while Saudi Arabia stages a FALSE FLAG ATTACK on the U.K
referrals.note: The title contains a categorical false-flag assertion. Capture the spoken claim, claimed actor, target event and evidence before any WOL promotion.

referrals.subject: Valenti Videos title places scare quotes around the downed pilot and shootdown while questioning the 7,000-foot injured climb
referrals.note: CBS published the officer's account and declassified rescue material supporting the badly wounded 7,000-foot ridgeline account. Determine exactly what Valenti disputes before scoring.

referrals.subject: Valenti title: The Iran War escalates while Trump almost starts a NUCLEAR WAR with CHINA
referrals.note: Do not create a duplicate incident unless body review identifies a distinct proposition not already captured.

referrals.subject: Valenti title: Iranian President says The United States of America is A TERRORIST STATE (HE'S RIGHT)
referrals.note: The title is primarily attribution plus opinion. Review body only for distinct factual claims; do not score disagreement with the opinion itself.
